_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: Rope-person. ... Knappers like rope-people. ... You tie things to other things. ... That's most of being alive.
Going somewhere else. ... Knappers know the feeling. ... Rock is always going somewhere else. Very slowly. ... Stay a while. Rock does.
... Have we met. ... No. ... Rock says yes. ... Rock is very old. Rock mixes things up.
